observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor stage with dark backdrop and dramatic warm lighting, performance setting
observation.dancers: mixed group of women and men; women in main dancing line, men seated playing instruments in background
observation.formation_and_space: women form a horizontal line across the stage, holding hands or stepping in unison
observation.posture: upright torso, slight knee bends, upright carriage
observation.footwork: stepping side to side, gentle steps coordinated with drumming beats; detailed foot contact cannot be seen clearly due to long skirts
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held up at shoulder level with hands joined in a line, or bent at elbows with fists near shoulders
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal torso movement, maintaining upright posture with occasional level changes
observation.partnering: hand-in-hand formation among the women in the line
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing upright transitioning to low squatting/kneeling positions on the floor
observation.costume_and_props: women wear long dark dresses with patterned borders and large feathered headdresses; men are shirtless or in simple attire with feathered headbands
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details and weight shifts are obscured by long skirts and low lighting

signature_moments.what: women stand in a straight line holding hands with feathered headdresses, stepping in unison to the drumbeat
group in a line dips down into a low knee-bent posture while holding hands and stepping sideways
dancers drop to kneeling positions on the floor while maintaining steady drum rhythms
